parameters.name: DbId
parameters.description:
The database ID.

> Call these operations to obtain the database ID: [SearchDatabase](~~141876~~), [ListDatabases](~~141873~~), and [GetDatabase](~~141869~~).

parameters.name: Logic
parameters.description: Specifies whether the database is a logical database.

parameters.name: RealLoginUserUid
parameters.description: The Alibaba Cloud account UID of the API caller.<props="china"> For more information, see [Specify the caller of an API operation](~~2835451~~).</props>

parameters.name: Script
parameters.description: The SQL script to execute. You can specify Data Query Language (DQL), Data Definition Language (DDL), or Data Manipulation Language (DML) statements. The ability to execute DDL and DML statements depends on the instance's security settings.

parameters.name: Tid
parameters.description:
The tenant ID.

> To view the tenant ID, move the cursor over the profile picture in the upper-right corner of the console. For more information, see [View tenant information](~~181330~~).
